_provenance.values_source: Manuscript Section 5.1.3 and the argparse defaults in bikt_pres.py.
_provenance.note: Run once per dataset. With --all_data the estimator is also trained on the validation and test partitions, which is how the released checkpoints (pretrain_model/BiktPreS_<dataset>_all.pth) were produced. The resulting checkpoint is loaded by Stage 2 via --model_path and frozen.
